overview.zh: 币安遭黑客攻击后高管离职，同时多起安全事件与监管阻力凸显加密行业压力。 币安高层变动：币安首席财务官在平台遭朝鲜黑客窃取63亿美元后数日离职，引发内部治理质疑。 钱包安全漏洞：Keplr Wallet部分社交登录账户遭未授权交易，Web3Auth已暂停嵌入式钱包服务。 AI间谍指控：美情报备忘录称中国国安部招募科技高管，以监视英伟达CEO黄仁勋。
overview.en: Binance faces leadership change after hack, as multiple security incidents and regulatory pushback highlight industry strain. Binance Leadership Shift：Binance's CFO resigned days after a $6.3 billion theft from the platform by North Korean-linked hackers. Wallet Security Breach：Unauthorized transactions hit some Keplr Wallet social login accounts, prompting Web3Auth to suspend its embedded wallet service. AI Espionage Allegation：A US intelligence memo alleges China's Ministry of State Security recruited an executive to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

title.zh: 币安 CFO Kaiser Ng 在黑客窃取 63 亿美元数日后离职
title.en: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng steps down days after hackers steal $6.3-billion

summary.zh:
币安首席财务官（CFO）Kaiser Ng 已辞职，交易所任命前 Airwallex 财务高管 Justin Yek 为新任首席财务官。此次人事变动是在一次重大安全漏洞导致平台估计损失 63 亿美元后数日宣布的。

在发生史上最大规模的加密货币盗窃案之一后，一位关键财务高管迅速离职，引发了外界对这家全球最大加密货币交易所内部问责与治理的质疑。

联席首席执行官何一表示，Ng 的离职过渡计划在过去六个月中一直在实施，表明继任计划在黑客攻击前就已制定。此次黑客攻击发生在公告前约一周，第三方安全公司和美国联邦调查局（FBI）将其归因于与朝鲜有关联的黑客组织 TraderTraitor。
summary.en:
Binance CFO Kaiser Ng has resigned, and the exchange has named Justin Yek, a former finance executive at Airwallex, as its new Chief Financial Officer. The leadership change was announced just days after a major security breach resulted in an estimated $6.3 billion theft from the platform.

The departure of a key financial executive so soon after one of the largest crypto thefts in history raises questions about internal accountability and governance at the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange.

Co-CEO Yi He stated that a transition plan for Ng's departure had been in place for the past six months, suggesting the succession was planned prior to the hack. The hack, which occurred about a week before the announcement, is attributed by third-party security firms and the FBI to the North Korean state-linked hacking group TraderTraitor.

title.zh: 【Keplr Wallet 部分社交登录账户出现未授权交易，Web3Auth 因安全问题暂停嵌入式钱包服务】
title.en: Unauthorized Transactions Reported for Some Keplr Wallet Social Login Accounts; Web3Auth Suspends Embedded Wallet Service Due to Security Issue

summary.zh:
Web3Auth 宣布其服务出现安全问题，波及部分第三方平台，并已暂停嵌入式钱包服务。Keplr Wallet 则报告称，部分通过 Google 或 Apple 社交登录创建的账户发生了未授权交易，正与 Web3Auth 团队联合调查。

该事件已导致用户资产被未授权访问和损失，Keplr 已建议受影响用户停止存款并转移剩余流动资产。核心认证服务的暂停也影响了多个平台的钱包功能。

Keplr 的初步评估显示，使用助记词或硬件钱包创建的账户不受影响。Web3Auth 的初步调查未发现 MetaMask 用户受影响的证据。更多详情有待官方后续公布。
summary.en:
Web3Auth announced a security issue affecting its services and some third-party platforms, leading it to temporarily pause its embedded wallet service. Keplr Wallet separately reported that some user accounts created via Google or Apple social logins have experienced unauthorized transactions, and a joint investigation with Web3Auth is underway.

The incident has led to unauthorized access and loss of user assets, prompting Keplr to advise affected users to stop deposits and move remaining liquid assets. The suspension of a core authentication service also disrupts wallet functionality for multiple platforms.

Keplr's preliminary assessment indicates that accounts created with a recovery phrase or hardware wallet are not affected. Web3Auth's initial investigation found no evidence that MetaMask users are impacted. Further details are pending official announcements.

title.zh: 零点击 iOS 漏洞利用程序从活跃的 TRON 钱包中盗取 400 万美元 USDT
title.en: Zero-click iOS exploits drain $4M USDT from active TRON wallets

summary.zh:
根据 CryptoSlate 的报道，一种零点击 iOS 漏洞利用程序被用于从活跃的 TRON 钱包中盗取了约 400 万美元的 USDT。

该事件突显了一种无需用户交互即可入侵钱包的复杂攻击途径，对移动端加密资产安全构成重大威胁。

区块链分析公司 Bitquery 追踪了被盗的 USDT，涉及 365 个 TRON 地址，其中一条记录显示超过 519,000 USDT 于 10 月 25 日被转移到一个收集地址。
summary.en:
A zero-click iOS exploit has been used to steal approximately $4 million in USDT from active TRON wallets, according to a report from CryptoSlate.

This incident highlights a sophisticated attack vector that can compromise wallets without requiring any user interaction, posing a significant threat to mobile crypto asset security.

Blockchain analytics firm Bitquery traced the stolen USDT across 365 TRON addresses, with one record showing over 519,000 USDT transferred to a collector address on October 25.

title.zh: 【币安将于 2026 年 12 月 31 日关闭法国用户账户，11 月 29 日起收取每月 0.025% 的管理费】
title.en: Binance will close French user accounts on December 31, 2026, and start charging a monthly management fee of 0.025% from November 29

summary.zh:
因未能获得欧盟 MiCA 监管许可，币安法国（Binance France）将于 2026 年 12 月 31 日停止运营并关闭所有用户账户。自 2026 年 11 月 29 日起，仍持有资产的账户将被收取每月 0.025% 的托管费，最低收费为 10 USDC。

此举迫使币安法国实体的所有法国用户必须提取资产，否则将面临持续收费，并标志着币安从一个主要欧盟市场的受监管业务中完全退出。

存款功能目前已不可用。首次扣费将在 11 月 29 日后的 3 天内进行，第二次在 12 月 24 日或之后。在 12 月 31 日截止日期前未提取的资产，可能会根据币安的服务条款被转换、转移或以其他方式处理。
summary.en:
Binance France will cease operations and close all customer accounts by December 31, 2026, after failing to obtain authorization under the EU's MiCA regulation. Starting November 29, 2026, accounts still holding assets will be charged a monthly custody fee of 0.025%, with a minimum charge of 10 USDC.

This forces all French users of the Binance France entity to withdraw their assets or face recurring fees, and marks a complete withdrawal of Binance's regulated operations from a major EU market.

Deposit functions are already suspended. The first fee deduction will occur within three days after November 29, with a second on or after December 24. Assets not withdrawn by the December 31 deadline may be converted, transferred, or otherwise handled per Binance's Terms of Service.

title.zh: 据美国情报备忘录称，Megaspeed高管被招募监视英伟达CEO
title.en: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo

summary.zh:
据报道，一份美国情报备忘录称，中国国家安全部招募了一名女性科技高管，即Megaspeed高管Alice Huang，以监视英伟达CEO黄仁勋。

该事件突显了据称由国家支持、针对全球AI芯片行业关键人物的企业间谍活动，其目的可能是获取美国先进技术信息并影响公司政策。

该备忘录于今年早些时候流传。据报道，被招募的高管Alice Huang是黄仁勋的密友。
summary.en:
A US intelligence memo reportedly claims that China's Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive, identified as Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

The incident highlights alleged state-sponsored corporate espionage targeting a key figure in the global AI chip industry, potentially aimed at acquiring information about advanced US technology and influencing company policy.

The memo was circulated earlier this year. The recruited executive, Alice Huang, was reportedly a close friend of Jensen Huang.

title.zh: Anthropic仍计划于感恩节前启动IPO，估值最高1.75万亿美元，计划募资800亿至1000亿美元
title.en: Anthropic still plans to launch IPO before Thanksgiving, with valuation up to $1.75 trillion, aiming to raise $80 to $100 billion

summary.zh:
据英国《金融时报》报道，Anthropic计划在美国感恩节前推进首次公开募股，目标估值区间为1.25万亿至1.75万亿美元，计划募资800亿至1000亿美元。

此次IPO是一家领先AI实验室的关键市场事件，尽管近期科技股遭遇抛售，且面临OpenAI下调融资目标等市场压力，公司仍计划推进。

该公司第三季度营收增长近50%，达到约170亿美元，最新年化营收运行率约为810亿美元。未来数年计划投入约9000亿美元用于算力及基础设施建设。
summary.en:
Anthropic plans to proceed with its initial public offering before the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday, targeting a valuation range of $1.25 trillion to $1.75 trillion and aiming to raise $80 billion to $100 billion, according to a report by the Financial Times.

The IPO represents a pivotal market event for a leading AI lab, occurring despite a recent sell-off in tech stocks and market pressure from factors like OpenAI's reduced fundraising target.

The company's Q3 revenue grew nearly 50% to approximately $17 billion, with its latest annualized revenue run rate around $81 billion. It plans to invest about $900 billion in computing and infrastructure over the coming years.

title.zh: “美股七巨头”已全部退出OKX-ICE代币化股票平台，67家发行商提出反对
title.en: All of the Magnificent Seven have now opted out of the OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, with 67 issuers objecting

summary.zh:
由科技巨头组成的“美股七巨头”全部七家公司，以及总共67家股票发行商，已正式选择退出由OKX与ICE合资运营的计划中的代币化股票交易平台。这些退出是以向该合资公司（名为OKXICE TSV）发布的公开通知提出反对的形式进行的。

来自该平台初始股票选择中近80%的公司（包括其最高调的目标）的协同反对，在平台启动前就对其生存能力构成了严重威胁。这对传统股票的代币化进程构成了重大的监管和市场结构挑战。

该合资公司曾计划提供来自63家纽交所上市公司（包括英伟达、苹果、微软和特斯拉）的代币化股票的7x24小时交易。亚马逊、特斯拉、Netflix、富国银行和思科等公司的反对意见已在公开通知的更新中被报道。
summary.en:
All seven companies comprising the 'Magnificent Seven' tech giants, along with a total of 67 stock issuers, have formally opted out of the planned tokenized stock trading platform operated by the OKX-ICE joint venture. The opt-outs were filed as objections to a public notice from the venture, known as OKXICE TSV.

The coordinated objections from nearly 80% of the venture's initial stock selection, including its most high-profile targets, pose a severe threat to the platform's viability before launch. This represents a significant regulatory and market-structure challenge for the tokenization of traditional equities.

The joint venture had planned to offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from 63 NYSE-listed companies, including Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft, and Tesla. Objections from companies like Amazon, Tesla, Netflix, Wells Fargo, and Cisco have been reported in updates to the public notice.

title.zh: 为何一份关于Anthropic自动化AI开发的新报告令研究人员感到担忧
title.en: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers

summary.zh:
AI安全研究组织METR周四发布的一份报告发现，Anthropic利用AI自动化自身模型开发的效果显著，其模型改进速度比一年前大约快了一倍，且几乎没有放缓的迹象。

该报告表明AI进步速度可能出现范式转变，引发了重大的安全担忧，因为快速、自动化的自我改进可能使保障、监控和控制先进AI系统变得更加困难。

这些发现基于METR为期11周的调查，该组织是一个评估前沿AI模型能力及相关风险的非营利机构。
summary.en:
A report published Thursday by AI safety research organization METR found that Anthropic's use of AI to automate its own model development is working remarkably well, accelerating its model improvement rate roughly twofold compared to a year ago with little sign of slowing.

The report indicates a potential paradigm shift in the pace of AI progress, raising significant safety concerns as rapid, automated self-improvement could make it harder to secure, monitor, and control advanced AI systems.

The findings are based on an 11-week investigation by METR, a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models' capabilities and associated risks.

title.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦若担任银行委员会主席可能重塑加密规则
title.en: Elizabeth Warren Could Reshape Crypto Rules as Banking Chair

summary.zh:
根据近期报道，美国知名加密货币批评者、参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦有望从2027年1月起担任参议院银行委员会主席。

若担任主席，沃伦将对委员会的议程产生重大影响，可能优先推动对加密货币行业更严格的监督和立法。

这一潜在变动与委员会的资历规则相关，最早也要到2027年才会发生。沃伦此前曾提出《数字资产反洗钱法案》，旨在对该行业实施更严格的监管。
summary.en:
U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren, a prominent crypto critic, is in line to potentially chair the Senate Banking Committee starting in January 2027, according to recent reports.

As chair, Warren would wield significant influence over the committee's agenda, potentially prioritizing stricter oversight and legislation for the cryptocurrency industry.

The potential change is tied to the committee's seniority rules and would not occur until 2027. Warren has previously sponsored the Digital Asset Anti-Money Laundering Act, which seeks to impose stricter regulations on the industry.

title.zh: Loopscale 在攻击相关冻结后重新开放所有金库
title.en: Loopscale Reopens All Vaults After Attack-Related Freeze

summary.zh:
Loopscale 已全面重新开放其所有金库，包括 USDC Genesis Vault，并解除了剩余的贷款管理限制。此前，因一起安全事件，该协议暂停运营了约两天半。

此举恢复了用户对存款、取款和贷款管理的完全访问权限，标志着该协议从冻结用户资金的安全事件中恢复的重要一步。

该协议已承诺发布一份详细说明事件的技术性事后分析报告。此次全面重启是在部分恢复贷款功能之后进行的，此前部分恢复阶段仍冻结了金库提款并锁定了 USDC Genesis 贷款支持的抵押品。
summary.en:
Loopscale has fully reopened all its vaults, including the USDC Genesis Vault, and lifted remaining loan-management restrictions as of November 7, following a two-and-a-half-day protocol pause due to a security incident.

This action restores full user access to deposits, withdrawals, and loan management, marking a significant step in the protocol's recovery from the security incident that had frozen user funds.

The protocol has promised to release a technical post-mortem report detailing the incident. The reopening follows a partial restoration of loan functions that had kept vault withdrawals frozen and collateral on USDC Genesis-funded loans locked.

title.zh: 币安宣布新一轮涉及九个网络的提现阶段
title.en: Binance Announces Another Withdrawal Phase Across Nine Networks

summary.zh:
币安宣布了一项预定的提现阶段，将影响九个不同区块链网络上的资产。

该公告是一项重要的运营更新，将暂时暂停用户对多种资产的提现，需要用户据此规划其交易。
summary.en:
Binance has announced a scheduled withdrawal phase affecting assets on nine different blockchain networks.

The announcement is a significant operational update that will temporarily suspend user withdrawals for a wide range of assets, requiring users to plan their transactions accordingly.

title.zh: 比特币ETF单周流出12.8亿美元，创6月以来最差表现，2026年净流入转负
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs flip negative for 2026 after $1.28 billion outflow week, worst since June

summary.zh:
上周，美国现货比特币ETF录得12.8亿美元的净流出，这是自2024年6月以来最大规模的单周资金流出。此次流出导致美国现货比特币ETF在2026年的累计净流入转为负值。

年度净流入转为负值，标志着机构资金正显著从这些受监管的投资工具中撤出，而这些工具此前是比特币需求的主要来源之一。

该数据来源于被广泛引用的ETF资金流数据提供商Farside Investors。资金流出涉及多只基金，包括贝莱德的iShares比特币信托（IBIT）和富达的Wise Origin比特币基金（FBTC）等主要产品。
summary.en:
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced $1.28 billion in net outflows last week, marking the largest weekly withdrawal since June 2024. This outflow has turned the aggregate net flows for all U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs in 2026 negative.

The reversal to negative net flows for the year signals a significant shift in institutional capital movement away from these regulated investment vehicles, which had previously been a major source of demand for Bitcoin.

The data is sourced from Farside Investors, a widely referenced provider of ETF flow data. The outflows occurred across multiple funds, including major products like iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) and Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC).

title.zh: FinCEN对MEXC采取行动后，用户报告OKX、币安等交易所出现存款限制
title.en: Users Report Deposit Restrictions at OKX, Binance and Other Exchanges Following

summary.zh:
在美国财政部金融犯罪执法网络（FinCEN）针对MEXC Global发布特别措施令后，有社区用户报告称，从MEXC提现至OKX、币安、Gate等中心化交易所的资金正面临合规审查、存款延迟到账或被接收平台进行退款审核。此外，Bitget Wallet确认其卡充值服务目前不接受被识别为来自MEXC的资金。

主要交易所和钱包服务商报告的这些行动表明，它们对一项重大的美国监管行动采取了主动的、基于风险的合规应对，这可能在FinCEN命令生效前就影响用户的资金流动和交易所运营。

FinCEN的命令尚未生效，且与交易所相关的报告主要基于个别用户账户，而非官方的全平台限制公告。任何限制的范围以及受影响资金的最终处置方式尚不明确。
summary.en:
Following a FinCEN special measure order targeting MEXC Global, users have reported that funds withdrawn from MEXC to centralized exchanges like OKX, Binance, and Gate are facing compliance reviews, deposit holds, or refund reviews. Separately, Bitget Wallet confirmed its card top-up service is not accepting funds identified as originating from MEXC.

The reported actions by major exchanges and a wallet service indicate a proactive, risk-based compliance response to a significant U.S. regulatory action, potentially affecting user fund flows and exchange operations even before the FinCEN order takes effect.

The FinCEN order has not yet taken effect, and the exchange-related reports are based on individual user accounts rather than official platform-wide announcements. The scope of restrictions and the final disposition of affected funds remain unclear.

title.zh: Bitcoin Core开发者提出量子攻击抵押防御方案
title.en: Bitcoin Core Developer Proposes Quantum Attack Collateral Defense Scheme

summary.zh:
11月7日，Bitcoin Core开发者Cory Fields提出一项「量子地雷」方案，要求任何转移易受未来量子攻击的比特币时，需提供与币值相等的抵押品并经历一段等待期。

该提案是针对比特币安全模型未来潜在威胁的一种新颖且具体的防御机制，旨在提高量子攻击者从易受攻击钱包中盗取资产的成本。

合法持有者可在等待期内出示事先准备的秘密所有权证明，以取回资产并获得攻击者的抵押品。该提案还为私钥已丢失的休眠资产设计了一个可供挑战的拍卖机制。
summary.en:
Bitcoin Core developer Cory Fields proposed a 'quantum mine' scheme on November 7, which would require anyone moving bitcoins from wallets vulnerable to future quantum attacks to post collateral equal to the coins' value and undergo a waiting period.

The proposal represents a novel, concrete defense mechanism against a potential future threat to Bitcoin's security model, aiming to raise the cost for quantum attackers attempting to steal from vulnerable wallets.

Legitimate owners can claim their assets and the attacker's collateral by revealing a pre-prepared secret proof of ownership during the waiting period. The proposal also includes a challenge auction mechanism for dormant assets with lost private keys.
